title: Banks Act Directive D7/2020 — Calculation of derivative exposure amount for the purposes of determining the leverage ratio
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Calculation of derivative exposure amount for the purposes of determining the leverage ratio.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Calculation of derivative exposure amount for the purposes of determining the leverage ratio.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Calculation of derivative exposure amount for the purposes of determining the leverage ratio. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
